intro.title: Transparent guide prices. Final figures after the analysis.

notes.title: Good to know
notes.text: The actual price depends on roof covering, scaffolding, meter cabinet and travel distance. The Pronovo one-off subsidy (EIV) is currently CHF 360 per kWp for rooftop-mounted systems under 30 kWp (integrated CHF 400/kWp, as of EnFV 1.7.2026) — we check the applicable rate for your project and handle the application.
